ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 92% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to approximately 8% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Densely packed high-intensity clusters on both distal tips; sparse, high-intensity speckling pattern distributed across the lower 40% of the visible ventral area; discrete focal white spots present in the mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 78 degrees and a narrow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration frequency along the trailing boundary; prominent peaks with amplitudes of 10-25 pixels observed on the right lobe's inner trailing edge; less pronounced, more frequent serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups concentrated at the extreme distal margins (left and right tips) indicative of dense barnacle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal linear pixel streaks (parallel rake marks) located in the upper-outer quadrant of the left lobe; minor, less distinct linear disruptions visible in the lower medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal linear scarring on the upper left lobe; significant physical protrusion of bio-fouling (barnacles) on both distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white stippling or 'snow' pattern across the lower ventral surface bordering the water line.
